title: Revolutionizing Digital Pathology With the Power of Generative Artificial Intelligence and Foundation Models

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Revolutionizing Digital Pathology With the Power of Generative Artificial Intelligence and Foundation Models》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Digital pathology has transformed the traditional pathology practice of analyzing tissue under a microscope into a computer vision workflow.

evidence.text: Digital pathology has transformed the traditional pathology practice of analyzing tissue under a microscope into a computer vision workflow.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Revolutionizing Digital Pathology With the Power of Generative Artificial Intelligence and Foundation Models》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】The performance of task-specific AI/ML models depends on the availability of many annotated training datasets, which presents a rate-limiting factor for AI/ML development in pathology.

【Abstract · abstract-1-8】A foundation model is a large AI model trained using sizable data, which is later adapted (or fine-tuned) to perform different tasks using a modest amount of task-specific annotated data.

evidence.text: The performance of task-specific AI/ML models depends on the availability of many annotated training datasets, which presents a rate-limiting factor for AI/ML development in pathology.
A foundation model is a large AI model trained using sizable data, which is later adapted (or fine-tuned) to perform different tasks using a modest amount of task-specific annotated data.
